stories.headline: Nvidia tells manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US chip-license rule
stories.summary: Nvidia paused shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after Washington closed a remote-access loophole and moved to require licenses for advanced AI chip purchases. Singapore says it is in talks with the US to keep chip access; Nvidia GPU sellers are also restricting neocloud sales over Chinese access.
